question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard capabilities remain a bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway roadmap, and which child items should instead move to plugin or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The tracker spans dashboard product direction, persistent widget/workspace state, browser sandboxing, registry/install trust, and role visibility boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor selectively under review
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

options.title: Move optional pieces outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer the roadmap
options.body: Pause Wave 2+ if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor selectively under review
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history signal on the Control UI plugin-tab seam and adjacent product/security boundary.
